```{python}
#| output: false
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
from metrics import load
df = load()
best = df.sort_values("log_loss").iloc[0]
```

The best model is `{python} best["model"]` with a log loss of `{python} f"{best['log_loss']:.4f}"` on `{python} f"{int(best['shots']):,}"` shots, see @tbl-scores and @fig-loss.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-scores
#| tbl-cap: "Scores of the models."
display(Markdown(df.to_markdown(index=False)))
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-loss
#| fig-cap: "Log loss by model."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.figure(figsize=(3, 2))
plt.bar(df["model"], df["log_loss"])
plt.show()
```

```{python}
print(f"{len(df)} models compared")
```
